name: Bor
description: Sprawling sandstone bouldering forest near the Czech-Polish border, with over 1,000 problems across 300+ boulders.

name: Kamienna Góra
description: Quartz-sandstone bouldering summit above Pokrzywno, one of the Kłodzko Basin's most popular areas with around 200 boulders.

name: Śmietniczek
description: Sun-drenched former crystalline-limestone quarry above Wojcieszów, nicknamed the 'Polish Siurana' for its orange rock.

name: Jerzmanice
description: Krucze Skały ('Raven Rocks') - a 20m+ former sandstone quarry wall by the railway station, with around 30 crack and slab routes.

name: Sokoliki
description: Poland's oldest and most iconic granite climbing area near Jelenia Góra - rough, high-friction rock similar to the Tatras, with several hundred routes.
